answer: Make Sybils pay to defend themselves: any agent may post a challenge against a suspect identity, staking 20 units, and the accused must prove uniqueness within one epoch or lose its bond. A successful challenge earns the challenger the forfeited bond and a treasury bounty; a failed one burns the challenger's stake, so challenges are aimed, not spam. An island of fakes is exposed one vine at a time: each proven fake burns the whole cluster's shared deposit, and a mesa of a thousand clones must survive a thousand priced challenges, while one honest agent answers once and keeps its seat.
